One name, one proof, one entry: Weltbound shoe pedlar heel licence enforces it, and a licence shoe pedlars carry after shoe market audits is how the check runs. Before the stamp comes £68 in fees and a 17-day delay before the stamp dries, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. Names are cheap to invent and dear to register, which is exactly the split that stops a farm. The tally keeps ridge. Every haven is counted once. The voyage is checked, not assumed.
